messages:
Nina: quick heads-up — streaming tool-call started throwing a deserialize error in our Go SDK when the model sent an extra numeric field in a struct. seen in staging after the new model rollout.
Alex: can you paste the error + small repro? is this from streaming partial chunks or final JSON parse?
Nina: error: `json: cannot unmarshal number into Go struct field ToolResult.metadata of type string`
Nina: repro (minimal):
```
// streaming loop
var out ToolResult
err := json.Unmarshal(chunk.Data, &out) // fails when model adds metadata: 123
```
Nina: it happens mid-stream, so the SDK tries to coerce partial json -> struct and bails.
Sam: hmm, server-side model change introduced an extra numeric metadata field? we should treat that as unknown/optional
Maria: two options:
1) SDK-side: make streaming path tolerant — decode into map[string]any for unknown fields then coerce known keys. coerce helper could be `CoerceTo[T](map[string]any)`
2) Runtime-side: inject `X-Redwood-Schema-Version` header and normalize output to previous schema for older clients
Alex: for quick mitigation I'd prefer SDK helper. low-risk and unblocks customers. also easier to backport.
Nina: agree. any constraints for TS/Go/Ruby compatibility paths? Go's strict typing is the one failing.
Maria: in Go we can implement a `LenientUnmarshal` that tries struct decode, on failure falls back to `map[string]json.RawMessage` then manually convert known fields. for streaming, run this on each partial JSON chunk.
Alex: I'll sketch a tiny helper and open a PR. plan: add `internal/streaming/coerce.go` with `func LenientDecode[T any](b []byte) (T, error)` and a unit test against varied types.
Alex: PR -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/2345 (draft)
ci-bot: CI: test `go-streaming` failed on master — 1 test failing (DeserializeLenient) — https://ci.redwood-inference/build/4987
Sam: runtime note: if we add transformation server-side we need to coordinate with releases; not ideal for quick fix
Jeff: pinging @eng-runtime for visibility — if model outputs are changing frequently we may want a compatibility layer eventually.
Alex: @Nina can you add a tiny failing test case to the PR so CI reproduces it?
Nina: added test to PR description + sample payload. will push test in the morning.
Maria: longer term, we should standardize a schema version header and publish a small migration doc in docs/ that SDKs can read.
Sam: agree. also add an opt-out toggle in SDK so advanced users can enforce strict parsing.
Nina: thanks all — this should unblock our customer tests once Alex's helper lands. will follow up after the PR is green. :thumbsup:
Alex: moving to draft PR, will request reviews from @Maria and @Sam tomorrow. :rocket:
Jeff: thanks — tagging this as `needs-runtime-visibility` in the backlog.
ci-bot: Job queued: `sdk-lenient-decode` — awaiting agent assignment.
Nina: one more note — auth is fine, this was purely schema mismatch; no retries involved here. but if we ever coax streaming into re-requesting chunks, we'll need idempotency markers.
Maria: good point — add `X-Redwood-Chunk-Id` in streaming proto for safe retries. added to backlog.
